title: Ecstasy of Gold
artist: Ennio Morricone (The Good, The Bad and The Ugly OST)

drums.tags: Stomp and clap folk rock. The arrangement features a heavy, resonant kick drum on every beat, layered with crisp handclaps on the backbeat. A bright, percussive acoustic guitar plays a rhythmic strumming pattern emphasizing the downbeats. A tambourine provides high-frequency accents on the offbeats. The track is in 4/4 time at 110 BPM in the key of G Major. The production is dry with minimal reverb, focusing on the organic, woody textures of the percussion and acoustic strings. The dynamic structure alternates between a stripped-back kick and clap rhythm and a fuller arrangement with the acoustic guitar and tambourine.

bass.tags: Cinematic orchestral score with a focus on tension and rhythmic drive. The arrangement features a staccato string section playing repetitive, driving ostinatos in the cellos and violas, while violins provide high-pitched tremolo and soaring melodic lines. A prominent pipe organ enters with sustained, dissonant chords and melodic flourishes. Percussion consists of deep orchestral bass drums, sharp snare hits, and shimmering cymbals. Brass sections, including trumpets and trombones, provide powerful, staccato accents and long, swelling crescendos. The piece is in D minor with a tempo of 120 BPM in 4/4 time. Woodwinds, specifically flutes and oboes, add trills and rapid runs during transitions. The mix is wide with significant hall reverb, emphasizing the scale of the ensemble. The structure relies on a gradual build-up of layers, increasing in harmonic complexity and dynamic intensity toward a climactic resolution.
